name: TabList

props.name: activation
props.description: Specify whether the content tab should be activated automatically or manually

props.name: contained
props.description: Specify whether component is contained type

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Used for tabs within a grid, this makes it so tabs span the full container width and have the same width. Only available on contained tabs with <9 children

props.name: iconSize
props.description: If using `IconTab`, specify the size of the icon being used.

props.name: leftOverflowButtonProps
props.description: Provide the props that describe the left overflow button

props.name: light
props.description: Specify whether to use the light component variant

props.name: rightOverflowButtonProps
props.description: Provide the props that describe the right overflow button

props.name: scrollDebounceWait
props.description: Optionally provide a delay (in milliseconds) passed to the lodash debounce of the onScroll handler. This will impact the responsiveness of scroll arrow buttons rendering when scrolling to the first or last tab.

props.name: scrollIntoView
props.description: Choose whether to automatically scroll to newly selected tabs on component rerender

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the tabs. Supports `sm` and `md` for line tabs. Supports `sm`, `md`, and `lg` for contained tabs.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TabList rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
